description: Test file for indexed job utility functions in Kubernetes, including index calculation, failure handling, and pod management.

methods.name: TestCalculateSucceededIndexes
methods.description: Tests calculation of succeeded indexes and intervals based on pod phases and previous success data.

methods.name: TestIsIndexFailed
methods.description: Tests detection of failed indexes based on pod failure counts and policies.

methods.name: TestCalculateFailedIndexes
methods.description: Tests calculation of failed indexes from pod failure data and job status.

methods.name: TestGetPodsWithDelayedDeletionPerIndex
methods.description: Tests identification of pods that should have delayed deletion based on failure counts and timestamps.

methods.name: TestGetNewIndexFailureCountValue
methods.description: Tests retrieval and calculation of new index failure counts from pod annotations.

methods.name: TestIntervalsHaveIndex
methods.description: Tests whether specific indexes fall within defined intervals.

methods.name: TestFirstPendingIndexes
methods.description: Tests selection of the first pending indexes for job progress.

methods.name: TestAppendDuplicatedIndexPodsForRemoval
methods.description: Tests logic for removing duplicate pods per index and determining which to keep or remove.

methods.name: TestPodGenerateNameWithIndex
methods.description: Tests generation of pod names with index suffixes, respecting name length constraints.

methods.name: TestGetIndexFailureCount
methods.description: Tests extraction of index failure counts from pod annotations.
